defining_records.title: The O'Keeffe Problem: Captioning as Operative Semiotics — A Total Installation

captures.description: MISSPELLING SILENTLY REPAIRED, ARCHIVE GIVEN PRIMACY OVER ART HISTORY. The layer corrects «keeffe» to O'Keeffe, leads with the archive's framework — the caption as generative layer governing interpretation of the image — recovers the star-to-heart shift and semantic dispossession, and gives the art-historical reading of the flower paintings SECOND, as the alternative.

atoms.evidence: *The O'Keeffe Problem: Captioning as Operative Semiotics*
a conceptual framework in operative semiotics

inversions.span: The risk of an image losing its original, ambiguous, or pluralistic meaning once an authoritative caption locks it into a singular narrative.
inversions.against: operative captioning as an anchored, controlled intervention the work installs; the framework turned into a warning against captioning
